escena.titulo: Pyramids: why energy is never inverted

turnos.t: Three pyramids. The pyramid of numbers counts individuals, whatever their size, so it can be inverted: one oak tree supports 250 caterpillars. The pyramid of biomass shows standing mass at one moment, and in the sea it can invert, because phytoplankton reproduce so fast.

Never. It shows the flow of energy per unit area per unit time, and because energy is lost as heat in respiration and in faeces at every transfer, each level always has less than the one below. Oak 1,000, caterpillar 100, sparrow 10, sparrowhawk 1. Numbers and biomass are stocks, a snapshot. Energy is a rate. That distinction is what gets the seven marks.
